kind: Read-only source, signature, receipt and artifact-binding review for formal-support rows F13 and F14
method: Read both current Lean sources and retained theorem signatures; verify recorded source/checker/artifact hashes, declaration inventory, theorem counts and axiom log agreement. No Lean compiler rerun, empirical validation or new proof claim.
review_scope: Independent internal AI source/receipt review of these bounded packages; not a retrospective repository-wide proof audit.
important_scope: Empty proof-axiom reports do not remove theorem hypotheses, supplied model laws, correspondences or normative premises.

packages.title_zh: 必要损失、真实替代与认识校准
packages.title_en: Necessary loss, real alternatives and epistemic calibration
packages.claim_zh: 相对于明确可实现目标，必要损失须覆盖所有已表示可行成功途径；真实无损替代推翻必要性，末态恢复不抹去中途损失；每种处境各有途径不等于存在统一回应。
packages.claim_en: Relative to an attainable target, necessary loss covers every represented feasible successful route; a real lossless alternative defeats necessity, endpoint restoration does not erase interruption, and a route for each circumstance is not one uniform response.
packages.scope_zh: 目标、损失、回应范围、历史及可行规律供给；将候选集结论用于现实还须保留真实处境，集合缩小本身不保证这一点。11项定理/28项声明空依赖；未证明K、净善、许可、实际观察策略或全部现实替代已覆盖。
packages.scope_en: Target, loss, response repertoire, histories and feasibility law are supplied; applying candidate-set conclusions requires retaining the actual circumstance, which subset refinement alone does not ensure. Recorded 11 theorems/28 declarations with empty dependencies; no K, net goodness, permission, implemented observation policy or complete real-world alternative coverage is proved.
critical_hypotheses: NecessaryLoss includes existence of a successful response; impossible targets are not classified as having a necessary price.
Retained actuality is required to instantiate a universally certified candidate claim.
UniformLossless fixes one response across candidate circumstances; per-circumstance existence does not supply it.
The finite handover law stipulates three support stages and models no costs outside the represented interruption.
not_proved: Physical implementation or an empirical observation policy

packages.title_zh: 既有混合比较的减损传递
packages.title_en: Loss-reduction transport of an established mixed comparison
packages.claim_zh: 已成立严格优先在相容的匹配减损下保持；已成立拒绝在匹配增损下保持。损失敏感及传递性仍容许不同阈值，甚至接续优先于每个有限损失的关系。
packages.claim_en: Established strict priority survives compatible matched loss reduction; established rejection survives matched loss increase. Loss sensitivity and transitivity still admit different cutoffs, including continuation priority over every finite loss.
packages.scope_zh: 传递的Le、完整匹配NoWorse与其相容性、已成立严格比较均供给；推到实践理由另需PracticalBridge及两端可行性。16项定理/23声明；20项空依赖，3项仅propext与Quot.sound。未证明首个混合比较、K或普遍有限牺牲上限。
packages.scope_en: Transitive Le, fully matched NoWorse and compatibility, and an established strict comparison are supplied; practical reasons additionally need PracticalBridge and feasibility of both endpoints. Recorded 16 theorems/23 declarations: 20 empty, three only propext/Quot.sound. No first mixed comparison, K or universal finite sacrifice bound is proved.
critical_hypotheses: Strict comparison is Le a b together with not Le b a; transitivity transports an existing strict anchor.
Matched loss change must preserve relevant gain and all other adverse relationships; semantic adequacy of NoWorse is not derived.
The practical theorem separately supplies PracticalBridge and feasibility of baseline and improved options; it does not prove the bridge.
Faithful redescription preserves the full relation in both directions; arbitrary self-modification need not be faithful.
Duration controls hold gain, intensity, affected relationships and recovery content fixed; real calendar duration does not by itself meet this matching premise.
not_proved: First mixed comparison or first ethical warrant
Completeness, obligatory choice or arbitrary self-modification preservation

living_recovery_followup.review_scope: Availability and final source/checker/log binding check only, with proof note read; not a second full theorem-proof review.
living_recovery_followup.summary_zh: 已存在可信最终源绑定回执；不是仅初查。实际双向总输运与工作耦合可推出终点返回的必要预算，允许中途越界；不证明恢复存在、实际生理充分性、全生命覆盖或伦理根据。
living_recovery_followup.summary_en: A credible final source-bound receipt exists; this is no longer merely preliminary. Actual bidirectional gross transport and work coupling yield a necessary budget for a bounded endpoint while permitting intermediate excursions; no recovery existence, physiological sufficiency, universal living coverage or ethical warrant is proved.
